title: About Dra. Gabriella González Pane
subtitle: Twenty years of dentistry based on clinical judgment, written plans, and honest second opinions — in Spanish and English.
fraseGuia: Dentistry doesn't start with a drill. It starts by thinking.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: Dra. Gabriella González Pane graduated around 2005 from the Universidad Autónoma del Paraguay. Her practice has been guided by one rule ever since: think before touching. Over two decades she has seen thousands of patients, focused on operative dentistry, oral rehabilitation, aesthetics, and second-opinion reviews. Care in English for international patients is part of her regular work.

sections.heading: The 5 non-negotiable pillars
items: Think before touching — diagnosis, conversation, and planning before any procedure.
Preserve before replacing — every tooth structure preserved is preferable to every one lost.
Explain before selling — the patient must understand. Educate without infantilizing.
See people before teeth — the mouth belongs to someone with fear, budget, and history.
Refer when appropriate — a confident professional doesn't need to do everything.

sections.heading: Experience
items: ~20 years in operative dentistry, aesthetic dentistry, and oral rehabilitation.
13+ years of clinical work in Asunción.
~130 patients per month in her current practice.
Fluent English: established base of international patients.

sections.heading: Credentials
items: MSPBS: independent practice license in process.
Building an independent practice aligned with a clear professional identity.

sections.heading: Outside the clinic
sections.body: Lives in Luque. Likes colored scrubs. Has been using AI to analyze her cases and finances for years. She's building a space where private consultation with clinical judgment has a place in Paraguay — for patients who are tired of being sold procedures without being told why.

manifiestoCorto: I don't want to be chosen because of what I promise. I want to be chosen because they trust how I think.
